data.name: TimeFeesGrid_Desc
data.value: Editable grid of people against a workstream timeline: books hours per day, week or month, and shows rates, time fees and margin. Keyboard navigable, scrolls with the native scrollbars.

data.name: GridPeople_Desc
data.value: Bind colPeopleAllocated: Name, JobLevel, Team, CostRate, FeeRate, RPH, Realisation, JobLevelOrder, IsToBeAdded, CurrencyID. One row per person that can be allocated.

data.name: GridAllocations_Desc
data.value: Bind: AddColumns(colAllocatedHours, PersonName, Name, AllocationDate, Date). The component reads this table by column name, and Dataverse requires every property-set name to be unique across the whole control, so the person and the date are read through the PersonName and AllocationDate aliases (HoursWorked is read as it is). If a binding does not line up, the grid says which column it could not find instead of showing no hours at all. Hours dated outside the workstream window keep their date and hours, and come back with Value, Weekday and WeekNum set to 0 because the window no longer describes them.

data.name: GridTimeline_Desc
data.value: Optional. Bind colWorkstreamTimeline as it is: its Date, Value, Weekday, WeekNum, MonthNum and YearNum columns are read by name. Leave it unbound to generate a Monday to Friday timeline from the workstream start date and number of weeks.

data.name: WorkstreamStart_Desc
data.value: First day of the workstream. Used to generate the timeline when the timeline table is not bound, and for the period labels.

data.name: NumberOfWeeks_Desc
data.value: Length of the workstream in weeks (1-52). Each week counts five working days from the workstream start.

data.name: HoursPerDay_Desc
data.value: Hours a full working day holds (default 8). Hours booked in a period are spread day by day at this size, and the period capacity is working days x this value.

data.name: Phasing_Desc
data.value: Default grouping of the timeline columns. People using the grid can switch between daily, weekly and monthly.

data.name: Pricing_Desc
data.value: The app owns this: set it from your pricing control. Use "realisationAdjustment" (any text containing "realisation") to let the user type REAL% and derive RPH, or "manualRate" to let them type RPH and derive the realisation.

data.name: ReadOnly_Desc
data.value: Turn on for review screens: rates and hours cannot be edited, but the grid can still be navigated and re-phased.

data.name: ShowNotifications_Desc
data.value: Turn on to show the dataset warnings above the timeline (for example when an optional table is not bound). Turn off to keep the grid silent.

data.name: RequiredHeight_Desc
data.value: The height in pixels the grid needs to show the header, every person and the totals row without scrolling. Set the control's Height to Self.requiredHeight. When only this value changes, Changes carries the action "heightChanged", which OnChange can ignore.

data.name: Holidays_Desc
data.value: Optional. Dates that are not working days, as a JSON list such as ["2026-12-25","2026-12-28"] or JSON(colHolidays). Hours are never spread onto them and they do not count towards a period's capacity. Leave empty to treat every Monday to Friday as a working day.

data.name: ShowPricingBadge_Desc
data.value: Turn on to show the chip in the toolbar that names the pricing mode the app set (manual rate adjustment or realisation adjustment). Turn off to leave the grid unlabelled; the mode still decides which rate is editable.

data.name: AccentColor_Desc
data.value: Buttons, focus rings, the active cell and the selected phasing use this colour: #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or rgba(). The soft tints the grid paints behind the active row are derived from it.

data.name: BackgroundColor_Desc
data.value: Background of the grid viewport and the body rows. #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or rgba().

data.name: HeaderColor_Desc
data.value: Background of the timeline header row and the totals row. #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or rgba().

data.name: TextColor_Desc
data.value: Body text of the grid. #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or rgba().

data.name: OverCapacityColor_Desc
data.value: Fill of a period cell that holds more hours than that period can take. Only the individual cells are highlighted; the totals row reads the same as the rest of the grid. #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or rgba().

data.name: OverCapacityTextColor_Desc
data.value: Text colour of a period cell that holds more hours than that period can take, and of the warning banners above the grid. #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or rgba().

data.name: BorderColor_Desc
data.value: Cell separators, grid lines and the scrollbar. The stronger separators that face the scrolling timeline are derived from it. #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or rgba().

data.name: MutedTextColor_Desc
data.value: Job level and team under each name, header labels, totals captions and the hint strip. #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or rgba().

data.name: HoverColor_Desc
data.value: Fill of the row under the pointer. Keep it opaque so the pinned columns never show the timeline through them. #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or rgba().

data.name: SubtleBackgroundColor_Desc
data.value: Background of the toolbar, the help panel and the hint strip. #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or rgba().

data.name: DangerColor_Desc
data.value: Remove button on hover and the error banner text. The banner fill is derived from it. #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or rgba().

data.name: DataSchema_Desc
data.value: Internal: carries the output schema for canvas apps.

data.name: Changes_Desc
data.value: Latest change published by the grid: revision, action, personName, the allocations table and the people table. On the component's OnChange property, write the allocations back to colAllocatedHours and the rates back to colPeopleAllocated; the grid ignores the resulting dataset refresh, so writing back does not make it flicker or lose the cell being edited.

data.name: ChangesJson_Desc
data.value: Same payload as the Changes property, serialised, for apps that prefer to parse JSON.
